events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his voice defined a generation. What's your top track from the man himself?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was a reality. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day commemorates the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Celebrating decades of 007, from iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Which Lennon song resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique humour has brought us so much joy. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly showcased their evolving sound and songwriting. Which track from it is still on your playlist?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Memory
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His vision for peace and his timeless music continue to resonate globally. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?
